start_here: Say to your AI: "Send a ready message only when I say yes." The AI switches on this workflow's wake the-owner-said-yes; your yes to a notice about a mail draft sends that draft from your own account, and nothing else sends.
no_lists_because: It sends one saved draft and keeps one sent statement in the person's own history; it keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Have a mail rule row in your history that mentions $.after.to as an email, so the sent message joins that person's history.
2. Switch on the-owner-said-yes. Your yes tells owner-said-yes with the draft's id, provider, connection_id and to.
3. A draft sends once: the same yes told again is admitted once by the engine, and the draft is gone after it is sent.
